notes: TPM 2.0 Architecture (Part 1) defines the protocol-level command/response framing; the host-side MMIO register file (TPM_ACCESS, TPM_INT_ENABLE, TPM_STS, TPM_DATA_FIFO, etc.) is normatively defined in the platform-specific TPM Interface Specification (TIS) or PC Client Platform TPM Profile (PTP). Most platforms place the register file at base 0xFED40000 with per-locality 4 KB windows (locality n at 0xFED40000 + 0x1000*n).

registers.name: TPM_ACCESS
registers.description: Bus-ownership / locality-request register. Fields: tpmRegValidSts(b7), activeLocality(b5), beenSeized(b4), Seize(b3), pendingRequest(b2), requestUse(b1), tpmEstablishment(b0).

registers.name: TPM_INT_ENABLE
registers.description: Per-locality interrupt enable bits + interrupt polarity. Bits: globalIntEnable(b31), stsValidIntEnable(b1), localityChangeIntEnable(b2), commandReadyEnable(b0), dataAvailIntEnable(b0 alt).

registers.name: TPM_INT_VECTOR
registers.description: SERIRQ vector for the TPM interrupt (legacy LPC).

registers.name: TPM_INTF_CAPABILITY
registers.description: Interface capability vector. Reports interface version (TIS 1.x or PTP 1.x), supported transfer sizes, DataAvailIntSupport, InterruptLevel, etc.

registers.name: TPM_STS
registers.description: Main status / command-control register. Fields: stsValid(b7), commandReady(b6), tpmGo(b5), dataAvail(b4), Expect(b3), selfTestDone(b2), responseRetry(b1), commandCancel(b24), burstCount[15:8].

registers.name: TPM_DATA_FIFO
registers.description: FIFO byte register; host writes command octets and reads response octets here. burstCount in TPM_STS reports how many bytes may be transferred without polling.

registers.name: TPM_INTERFACE_ID
registers.description: PTP-only. Selects interface type (FIFO TIS, CRB) and reports interface version.

registers.name: TPM_XDATA_FIFO
registers.description: Optional 32-bit-wide alias of TPM_DATA_FIFO for faster bulk transfer.

registers.name: TPM_DID_VID
registers.description: Device ID (upper 16) and Vendor ID (lower 16). Vendor IDs include 0x1014 IBM, 0x1022 AMD, 0x15D1 Infineon, 0x104A STMicro, 0x1050 Nuvoton, 0x8086 Intel.

internal_state_summary: Persistent hierarchies (4) with authValue, authPolicy, and proof seeds.
Slot table — small, vendor-defined number of transient object slots (typical 3..7) and session slots (typical 3..16); on overflow, host must TPM2_ContextSave to spill.
